lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: Reward: Gem ×50

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: I end up saying that to you quite often, I find.
What did I do?

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: You helped me gather the parts I needed,

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: so I was able to fix the coffin.

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: I also promised to make a bed for Cinderella.

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: None of that would have been possible without you.
You're the one who offered to make her a bed. How did I contribute in any way?

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: If I was alone,

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: I would have been too scared to do anything.

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: Since you were with me, however, I was even able to revive Cinderella.

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: I'm thankful for that.
I didn't know you were that scared.

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: A coffin is not a place for the living to lie in.

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: Despite that,

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: Cinderella lived in one for a long time,

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: in a perpetual state of near-death.

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: When she lay down in that coffin and closed her eyes again,

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: it felt like death was coming for her.

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: I felt transported back to that horrible time again.
That sounds terrible.

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: It was.
You must have felt very uneasy.

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: I was.

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: I was very thankful

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: when Cinderella promised never to do that again,

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: and so I'm going to make her a bed.

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: One meant for the living.

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: A place to sleep, not to die.

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: I like the sound of that.

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: I'm going to make the finest bed I possibly can.
I'm sure you will.

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: I'll give her the best bed

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: she has ever slept in.

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: I'll contact you once it's finished.

lines.speaker: coffin
lines.text: You can come and see it.
Sounds great. I can't wait.
